subject: de Winter's s(268) and s(270) certificates (#1021, #1022), and the houses T-289 and T-283
stated: 18 November 2026, frozen with the checker before any program of this lane read a certificate

conventions.past: epsilon = 1/10^40; 'contact' is exactly 0, 'past' is exactly epsilon beyond it
conventions.clearances: (L, B, R, T): a square's signed distances to the left, bottom, right and top walls, from method A on the original certificate
conventions.W: the least right-or-top clearance of the original certificate
conventions.lambda*: the largest contact factor over all pairs (r1021_contract); f the pair's own factor; H the pair's summed half-width
conventions.verdicts: ACCEPT or REFUSE is the checker's verdict on the changed file(s): r1021_check.check_report for a report (both forms, both methods, natively and crossed), check_house for a house
conventions.reader controls: decided by the readers and the twin only; 'refused' means a ReadError
conventions.every rule: is evaluated exactly over the original certificate's exact facts; a control is 'as stated' only when every clause of its rule holds

controls.change: form J: the last row deleted
form J: the side written as 2p/2q
controls.stated: read; flagged not-lowest-terms at the side and nowhere else new; the side's value unchanged

controls.change: form J: rows 1 and 2 exchanged
controls.stated: read; the twin fails at exactly squares 1 and 2

controls.change: form J: the side as its 40-place decimal, rounded down
form J: a plus sign on row 1's first scalar
form J: row 1's first scalar as a bare JSON integer 1
form J: the key n stated twice

form J: row 1's first scalar as -0
form J: a leading zero on row 1's first scalar
corners file: the last square deleted
corners file: the side written as 2p/2q
controls.stated: read; flagged not-lowest-terms at the side; the side's value unchanged

controls.change: form C: the corner blocks of squares 1 and 2 exchanged, ids kept in order
controls.stated: read; the twin fails at exactly squares 1 and 2

controls.change: corners file: the side as its 40-place decimal, rounded down
corners file: a plus sign on square 1's first corner x
corners file: square 1's first corner x double-quoted
corners file: the key n stated twice
corners file: an anchor on n
corners file: a tab in the n line
corners file: the ids of squares 1 and 2 exchanged
corners file: square 1's first corner x as -0
corners file: a leading zero on square 1's first corner x
form J: every (cos, sin) read as (cos, -sin), form C unchanged
controls.stated: read; the twin fails at exactly the squares that are not upright (cos and sin both nonzero)

controls.change: square n given square 1's pose (both forms; a house's file)
controls.stated: REFUSE; the only overlap is (1, n), with margin exactly -1 by A and area exactly 1 both ways by B; every pair (k, n), 1 < k < n, has the original margin of (1, k)

controls.change: square 1 translated by (S, 0)
controls.stated: REFUSE; square 1's clearances exactly (L + S, B, R - S, T); its area inside the box 0 by B; no pair overlapping by A or B

controls.change: square 1's first corner moved by epsilon in x in the corners file only
controls.stated: REFUSE; square 1 is not a unit square by its corners (A's derivation and B), and no other square is; for a report the twin fails at square 1 only and form J alone is accepted by both methods

controls.change: the corners file listed in reverse at every square
controls.stated: ACCEPT; every margin and clearance identical to the original's; for a report the twin's sense is reversed at every square

controls.change: transposed, (x, y) -> (y, x), in both forms
controls.stated: ACCEPT; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (B, L, T, R)

controls.change: quarter turn, (x, y) -> (S - y, x), in both forms
controls.stated: ACCEPT; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (T, L, B, R)

controls.change: mirrored, (x, y) -> (S - x, y), in both forms
controls.stated: ACCEPT; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (R, B, L, T)

controls.change: the side lowered by delta = epsilon
the side lowered by delta = 1/q, q the side's denominator in lowest terms
the side lowered by delta = W
the side lowered by delta = W + epsilon
the side set to its 12-place ceiling (for a report, the claim's print)
the side set to its 12-place ceiling less 1/10^12
(the rule S1a to S1f follow)
controls.stated: with delta = S - S', every margin identical; clearances exactly (L, B, R - delta, T - delta); ACCEPT exactly when delta <= W; the squares touching each wall and the squares crossing are exactly those the new clearances give

controls.change: translated by (-min L, -min B), the side set to the extent X (the larger of width and height)
controls.stated: ACCEPT; every margin identical; clearances exactly (L - Lmin, B - Bmin, R - (S - X - Lmin), T - (S - X - Bmin)); the touching squares exactly those the new clearances give

controls.change: E1c's packing with the side X - epsilon
controls.stated: REFUSE; the crossing squares exactly those whose E1c right or top clearance is below epsilon

controls.change: every centre scaled by lambda*, moved to the corner, the side the shrunk side
controls.stated: ACCEPT; every margin exactly lambda*(m + H) - H, m the original margin; the touching pairs exactly the pairs with f = lambda*

controls.change: every centre scaled by lambda*(1 - epsilon), moved to the corner, the side its extent
controls.stated: REFUSE; the overlapping pairs exactly those with f > lambda*(1 - epsilon), every margin exactly lambda*(1 - epsilon)(m + H) - H

controls.change: K1c's packing in a box epsilon smaller
controls.stated: REFUSE; the crossing squares exactly those whose K1c right or top clearance is below epsilon; every margin identical to K1c's

controls.change: every pair, on its own, closed along its line of centres to contact and to epsilon past (square j moved)
controls.stated: A's margin exactly 0 and exactly -epsilon; B contact both ways (area 0) and overlap both ways with equal positive areas

controls.change: every square, on its own, moved perpendicular to its nearest wall to contact and epsilon past
controls.stated: A's clearance at that wall exactly 0 and exactly -epsilon; B touching and crossing at that wall; B's area inside the box exactly 1 at contact and below 1 past

controls.change: none: a third reading of every margin and clearance from the corners file's corners
controls.stated: every pair's margin from the corners' projections onto the four edge directions equals A's margin exactly; every clearance from the corners' extremes equals A's

controls.change: the controls with a stated verdict, rerun with the checker's verdict replaced by a constant ACCEPT and by a constant REFUSE
controls.stated: the constant ACCEPT checker fails every control stated REFUSE and the constant REFUSE checker every control stated ACCEPT; each fails at least one
